Joshua Jackson is teasing his daughter’s Halloween costume.
Speaking with E! News at the Airbnb.org Gala on Wednesday, Oct. 28, the Doctor Odyssey star, 48, revealed that his ex-wife Jodie Turner-Smith is getting his 6-year-old daughter Juno ’s Halloween costume together. Jackson told the outlet that his little girl is “very specific” about the type of costume she wants.
“This is Mom’s costume year,” Jackson said. “She is very specific about what she wants. So, Mom is on that.”
Teasing his daughter’s outfit, the doting dad shared the 6-year-old “will be the most amazing gentry child that has ever gentry child.”
Last April, during an appearance on Jesse Tyler Ferguson ‘s Dinner’s on Me podcast , Jackson opened up about his divorce and shared that he will always put his daughter first, despite all of life’s outside factors. Jackson described fatherhood as an “important” job.
“If I ever did anything to estrange my daughter from myself, I would be in duress,” he said. “I actually can’t conceive of it because I don’t even wanna think of the pain that that would be.”
“Regardless of how messy the divorce is, beautiful the divorce is, easy [or] hard the co-parenting is ... I think this generation of dads is understanding, like ‘I need to be here. It’s gonna be hard, but this is important, and I’ve got to do this,’ “ he continued. “It’s my job – shared with my ex-wife – to do everything that we can to nurture you, cultivate you and give you all the tools that you need in life.”
The Dawson’s Creek alum’s childhood home — in which he still lived with his daughter Juno – was affected by the wildfires that devastated Los Angeles , but he’s focused on the silver linings. During an appearance on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon in March, Jackson spoke about how his home burned down during the fires in January and shared that he’s in some ways “actually excited for the opportunity” to rebuild.
“When I went to go see it, I’m standing in front of this thing, and it’s still literally smoking. And I’m looking at it, I’m like, ‘This bears no relation to my home. This is just a pile of stuff that burned in a fire,’ ” he said.
“And in some ways, I’m actually excited for the opportunity...that house has given me so much over the years, right? And I have loved it, and it has loved me,” he continued. “It has everything: the heartbreak, the baby, just life. All of life is in there.”
“Every floorboard is a piece of my story. And I’m excited to build a new house that doesn’t have all of Daddy’s history in it, that is for her and I,” the proud dad said. “So when she grows up, every floorboard has her story in it. And so in some ways, it’s not how I would have chosen to do a remodel, but in some ways I’m actually excited about the process.”

While Jackson and his ex-wife have decided to keep their daughter out of the spotlight, Jackson recounted a sweet moment he shared with his little one in September 2024.
As he opened up about the joys of fatherhood in a rare candid moment on Instagram, the actor shared a photo of him smiling at the camera while wearing a colorful beaded necklace. He wrote, “I wanted to share the story of that photo. This morning after breakfast I told my daughter I was going to go do some yard work. She asked if she could come with me, which is of course a yes.”
“We were just about to step outside when she said, ‘Daddy, I think inside play is what I need right now,’ “ he continued, explaining he left Juno with her grandmother and returned to “dad therapy” in the backyard. “And when I come back in, she presents me with this necklace. And tells me, ‘dada I wanted to stay inside so I could make you a necklace.’ ”
